messages:
mira: quick check — ran compact-sampling + 4-bit quant on llama-x-13b (q4_0) vs baseline fp16 on dev slice (1k prompts). Throughput +1.8x, latency p95 down 28%, but MMLU micro avg drops 3.2 pts. logs & config below. any red flags?
jon: can you paste eval breakdown by subject? also what's the rng/seed stability.
eva: how many samples per prompt? was temperature changed? :thinking: 
mira: 1 sample per prompt, temp=0.0 for mmlu runs. seed fixed. below is the exact rollout snippet.
mira: ```yaml
model: llama-x-13b
quant: q4_0
sampling: compact-spec
samples_per_input: 1
temp: 0.0
batch_size: 16
prompt_set: mmlu_dev_1000
eval_seed: 42
```
perf-bot: perf summary: throughput 1.82x, p50 46ms->26ms, p95 180ms->130ms, tokens/sec +78%
mira: metric breakdown snippet:
mira: ```text
mmlu_overall: 72.4 -> 69.2 (-3.2)
mmlu_math: 68.1 -> 64.0 (-4.1)
mmlu_chem: 74.5 -> 73.8 (-0.7)
commonsense: 80.0 -> 79.5 (-0.5)
```
jon: interesting the math slice regresses most — could be numeric tokenization under quant. can you run single-token-log-prob diffs on a small subset?
eva: also please run same setup with compact-spec but fp16 (no quant) to separate sampling vs quant effects.
mira: queued that. initial hunch: compact-spec introduces occasional early-exit hypotheses that hurt numeric generation. plan: (1) compact-spec + fp16, (2) q4_0 + topk=40, (3) q4_0 + remove compact heuristics.
jon: if regression persists, we should gate this behind canary with auto-fallback to fp16. propose rollout: 1% traffic, 24h, watch mmlu prompt-set + user-quality signals.
eva: ack. add alert if mmlu_delta < -2 after 2h. Also add perf regression guard.
mira: agreed. I'll post short results once the runs finish. :thumbsup: 
jon: thx, ping when done.
